name: RES Solar
old_description: RES Solar is New England’s solar hot water specialist, designing, repairing and installing custom solar hot water systems for homes and businesses from our Cohasset, Massachusetts headquarters. With more than 1000 solar hot water systems installed across the region, we know how to size, place, and tune a system to squeeze the most out of every ray. . Cleaner energy, lower bills, and a system built to last decades. That’s solar hot water, done right.
about:
RES Solar operates from Cohasset, Massachusetts, serving the New England region as a specialist in solar hot water systems. The company was established as a dedicated solar thermal contractor, though its exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm designs, installs, and repairs custom solar hot water systems for residential and commercial customers. To date, it has completed more than 1,000 installations across New England, handling each project from sizing and placement to final tuning. The company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual production volumes.

Its customer base includes homeowners and businesses seeking renewable hot water solutions. The company focuses exclusively on solar thermal applications rather than photovoltaic electricity generation, serving both new construction and retrofit projects throughout the Northeast.

RES Solar emphasizes system longevity and energy savings, stating that its installations are built to last decades while delivering cleaner energy and lower utility bills. The company positions its expertise in system sizing and tuning as a key differentiator for maximizing solar harvest in the New England climate.
